comment: The component descriptions focus on facility-based and national platform levels. Community health worker workflows, which represent the primary data collection and service delivery point for the majority of populations DPI-H is intended to reach, are not addressed as a distinct architecture concern. In Kenya and Zambia, CHW-facing applications are where most household and community-level health data originates, yet there is no component or interface description that covers this layer.

public.text: The component descriptions focus on facility-based and national platform levels. Community health worker workflows, which represent the primary data collection and service delivery point for the majority of populations DPI-H is intended to reach, are not addressed as a distinct architecture concern. In Kenya and Zambia, CHW-facing applications are where most household and community-level health data originates, yet there is no component or interface description that covers this layer.
public.suggestedRevision: Recognize CHW-facing application requirements as a distinct architecture concern, either as a component or as a defined interface layer, with guidance on how community-level data flows connect to the foundational shared data layer.
